explanation: Try every possible start index. Split the candidate into fixed-width words and compare their multiplicities against the required word counter, rejecting unknown or overrepresented words early.
timeComplexity: O(nmw+mw) expected worst case for text length n, m words and word width w
spaceComplexity: O(mw) temporary word-counter character storage, plus output indices
